statement: Conditional norm algebraicity propagates to the CM division hull; real and complex division values have explicit polynomial degree envelopes and uniformly bounded heights. Finite translate families have transcendence-degree cap three over Qbar. The resulting proved envelopes do not verify the variable-degree GMW1986 criterion; arithmetic-germ criteria fail the transcendental tangent hypothesis.
depends_on: C.4.2; C.7.6; C.7.9; GMW1986Theorem2.1; Herblot2012Theorem6.1; Gasbarri2010Theorem4.16
notes: Real bound D*n^4; complex bound 2*D*n^6; fixed translate family bound O(n^5). GMW certificate comparisons N^12 versus N^3 and N^20 versus N^6 do not establish any actual degree lower bound. Norm algebraicity for E361 remains undecided.
